sourcePolicy: Curated rules are reviewed in-repo and link to authoritative standards.

rules.title: Native select does not support readonly
rules.message: The HTML readonly attribute is not relevant to select. Do not model this as native readonly support.

alternatives.title: Keep the select enabled and control changes
alternatives.description: Preserves focus and normal form semantics, but requires an explicit product and interaction decision for preventing changes.

alternatives.title: Use a read-only display with a submitted value
alternatives.description: Show the selected value as non-editable content and preserve submission with an explicitly managed hidden value when required.

alternatives.title: Use disabled only when its semantics are acceptable
alternatives.description: Disabled controls cannot be interacted with and have different focus and form-submission behavior; it is not an unconditional readonly replacement.
